1. **Statin use and risk of dementia or Alzheimer's disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies.**
   Authors: Elena Olmastroni, Giulia Molari, Noemi De Beni, Ornella Colpani, Federica Galimberti, Marta Gazzotti, Alberto Zambon, Alberico L Catapano, Manuela Casula
   Journal: European journal of preventive cardiology
   Year: 2022
   URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34871380/
   Abstract: As the potential impact of statins on cognitive decline and dementia is still debated, we conducted a meta-analysis of observational studies to examine the effect of statin use on the risk of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and dementia.
